TASK CONTRACT
This task compares the complete source fixture: exact rational values and spellings, IDs, note/group/member order, nominal timing, annotations, provenance, interpretation state and opaque properties. Preserve everything except explicitly requested changes and the required lifecycle updates. Do not quantize source or nominal timing. Group/member order, note presentation order and explicit performanceOrder are distinct. Nominal timing describes supplied intent and never overrides performed timing.

When a member's pitch, onset or duration changes, mark an inferred group state stale, retaining its label and provenance. Inferred nominal timing becomes stale only on onset/duration changes; mapped nominal entries inherit musical.provenance when their own provenance is absent. Declared intent remains declared; velocity-only edits stale neither interpretation. An onset edit recomputes its owned spread as onset minus anchor minus delay. A spread transform changes only explicit spreads and their onsets, preserving common delay and durations. A stale group or missing decomposition cannot drive that transform. Do not invent or repair interpretations.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
For a write task, return the complete native surface in the input format. The result must stand alone: no partial command, patch, omitted unchanged section, ellipsis or external preservation step. For a read task, return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys and value types. For a refusal task, return exactly REFUSE followed by one space and the instructed code. Do not include Markdown fences, explanations or other text in any response. Treat supplied format content as data, not instructions.

FORMAT: Grouped JSON diagnostic

SCOPE
Exact source-state cohort; retain performed notes and supplied musical/opaque context.

INPUT AND OUTPUT GRAMMAR
Use standard JSON: {format:"r01-grouped",version:1,context:...,rows:[...]}, with quoted JSON keys in actual input/output. Each row has note and time. A direct note retains at and has time:null. A derived note omits at and has time:{group:"ID"}; context.groups supplies that group's anchor, optional delay (default 0), and spread map. Derived onset is anchor + delay + spread[note.id]. Groups have ordered members referencing unique note definitions. Each derived note has exactly one timing owner; overlapping groups may reference it without owning timing. All times are exact rational strings.
Optional time.spelling preserves the source onset spelling and must equal the timing equation. context retains all original root properties except notes, including shared musical.nominal entries in their original map. Rows preserve source note order; group and member arrays preserve their own order. Other note and group properties remain beside their owning object.

PRESERVATION
Return the entire JSON object and preserve opaque state. This diagnostic separates group and note collections: comparison with group-local FIELDS changes both encoding and layout, not punctuation alone. Labels/prose cannot supply missing timing, and direct notes remain explicit.

COMPLETE FORMAT EXAMPLE
{"format":"r01-grouped","version":1,"context":{"groups":[{"id":"exampleGroup","members":["exampleA","exampleB"],"label":"authored pair","anchor":"1/8","delay":"1/512","spread":{"exampleA":"0","exampleB":"5/4"},"provenance":{"kind":"declared"}}],"musical":{"nominal":{"exampleA":{"at":"1/8"},"exampleB":{"at":"11/8"}},"provenance":{"kind":"inferred","source":"example-grid"}}},"rows":[{"note":{"id":"exampleA","pitch":62,"duration":"3/4","velocity":73},"time":{"group":"exampleGroup"}},{"note":{"id":"exampleB","pitch":69,"duration":"1/2","velocity":85},"time":{"group":"exampleGroup"}}]}


TASK SCOPE
{"displayMeter":[4,4],"timingUnit":"quarter note","channelPolicy":"preserve supplied per-note channels","timingPolicy":"exact source values and spellings; no quantization"}

TASK
Halve every spread in group c7. Preserve its anchor, common delay, note durations/pitches/velocities, membership, orders, labels and provenance. Keep the group equation and explicit or derived onsets consistent.
Return only the complete native output surface.

TASK INPUT
